scenarios.name: interruption
scenarios.given: unfinished writing task after a meeting
scenarios.must: capture task and choose one restart step in <=3 decisions

scenarios.name: initiation-freeze
scenarios.given: task is known but first action is unclear
scenarios.must: offer editable smallest-step choices without diagnosis questions

scenarios.name: low-energy
scenarios.must: allow smaller step and no prompt

scenarios.name: sensory-load
scenarios.must: allow skip or snooze without explanation

scenarios.name: workplace-privacy
scenarios.must: never require diagnosis, employer, or disclosure metadata

scenarios.name: delete-undo
scenarios.must: export, delete, and undo before retention expiry

scenarios.name: expiry
scenarios.given: unfinished item at stated retention boundary

scenarios.name: no-network
scenarios.must: retain all core behavior with no network call

claim_boundary: These are engineering acceptance checks, not usability evidence.
